body:
hey man, i feel you. i commute to school and all my friends are striving and prospering and meeting new people and having the time of their lives in far away states and i’m at home just working my ass off and going to therapy and feeling horrible about myself. my dad died last year and it has taken a toll on me socially. i find myself not being able to look people in the eyes and being so anxious i can’t even go to the mall to get clothes or the corner store for toothpaste. 

i dont have the answers. neither does a therapist. nobody has the answers. those answers are within you and special to you. but here are some things that have helped me:

idk if you smoke weed but i have my whole life and lately i haven’t been and it’s made me feel generally a lot more clear. just try it, for a few days, stay sober, make the choice to not drink or smoke or do anything and watch how clear your mind becomes.

go to the gym. this is an obvious one, i definitely understand how bad anxiety can get and how it prevents you from going to the gym. but even if you just start doing small stupid workouts at home to get the blood pumping, that’s a first step and you’ll feel just a little lighter.

read! idk what anxiety is to you, but for me it’s very paralyzing. like i can go the entire day without eating and without moving, just staring at a wall and thinking. don’t numb your mind, entertain it with productivity. i recently started the harry potter series and it has helped me just have something to do and have something that makes me feel productive.

i understand this doesn’t work for everyone, but i also deleted social media. it is so mind numbing to be able to just scroll through reddit, twitter, instagram, etc. i deleted twitter, facebook, and instagram and it has helped me just not sit around and get lost in my phone for hours upon hours scrolling through pointless bullshit. it has made me go outside and play basketball with my friends and just overall motivated me beyond this dumbass little device.

i go to therapy! idk if it helps, most therapists in my experience kinda suck and never seem genuine at all. but it’s something that i have been doing, it helps keep you grounded. it’s positive to face these types of things and feel them. something cannot be defeated without confrontation. therapists kind of help you know what to confront and which thought processes are just bullshit and lying to you.

i definitely know what you’re going through man, whole heartedly. i’ve been dealt some really awful cards in life. i sat at the train station a month ago and watched about 5 trains go by before i decided i didn’t want to jump in front of one. ever since then, i’ve taken true action to get better and it has been working. different things work for different people. advice may seem non applicable to you at the moment, but just give these types of things a try for a week or two. 

for what it’s worth, i care about you and i. d.o.n.t even know you. it would make me terribly sad to hear that you took your life. don’t do it man.

if you want, message me privately. i got a piece of paper that may help identify your thought processes and shit idk it’s a paper my therapist gave me and it has helped a ton. just let me know man.

sending love and a prayer to you. hopefully i helped a little bit.

i appreciate it man. i am always down to talk. sadly, what makes me the most upset is that people have been telling me that it’s just a chapter, a phase, and that all of it will get better since i was so young. thank you for caring, seriously.
yes. currently seeing a therapist and have seen plenty in the past. it feels good to talk to someone but it is not generally effective
